details: @animebails/baileys reuses the exact basename of the @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp library but is published under a scope unrelated to that package. This record is metadata-only: version 0.0.0-stage is a 341-byte name-reservation artifact containing exactly two files, package.json ({"name":"@animebails/baileys","version":"0.0.0-stage","stub":true,"description":"Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing"}) and README.md stating "Temporary Holding Version … a temporary placeholder for this package. An operational version to replace this has been submitted for review and is awaiting a staged release." There are no lifecycle scripts, no bin entries, no dependencies, no JavaScript, no encoded string literals and no network code, so this specific version executes nothing. It has no network IOC. Consumers should not resolve the baileys library from the @animebails scope, and the name should be treated as reserved by an impersonating scope that announces a code-bearing replacement version.
